description: List a page's saved versions, newest first: version number, date, author, which app made the edit (edited_via: web, api_token, space_token or oauth; token_name: the token or app name) and the text length. The text itself is left out; read one version with get_page_version. Several saves by the same author through the same app within 10 minutes share one entry, so version numbers can skip.

limit.description: How many of the newest versions to return (default 50, max 200).

name: list_page_versions
title: List page versions
